feeds.title: The PartnerShip Connection Blog
feeds.description: The PartnerShip Connection is your small business resource for industry tips, trends, and opinions in the world of shipping. This blog is co-authored by various members of our PartnerShip LLC staff. Stay informed and competitive with relevant business insights.

feeds.title: DIY Marketers
feeds.description: DIY Marketing Ideas for Small Business. DIYMarketers helps you explore, find and implement creative, low cost marketing ideas. With our focus on the latest tools, tips and marketing ideas to stimulate your imagination, we make marketing your small business fun and easy.

feeds.title: Cleveland.com
feeds.description: Cleveland.com stands as Ohio's foremost source for comprehensive news and information, spanning local and national topics. From weather updates to traffic reports, and sports coverage to arts and entertainment, it offers a diverse range of content including videos, photos, forums, and up-to-date news articles, serving the Northeast Ohio community with reliable and timely information.

feeds.title: Manufacturing Advocacy and Growth Network Blog
feeds.description: The MAGNET blog regularly publishes manufacturing industry content, covers the latest news, and features growth tips and guides for your company. Gain valuable insights and stay at the forefront of the manufacturing industry. MAGNET is a business consultancy supporting small and medium-sized manufacturing business in Ohio.

feeds.title: Ohio Business Magazine
feeds.description: Ohio Business Magazine is the state's exclusive publication for business professionals in Ohio. From insightful features on thriving enterprises to in-depth analyses of emerging industries, it offers a comprehensive perspective of the state's evolving business landscape and other exciting content.

feeds.title: JumpStart Blog
feeds.description: JumpStart Inc. is a nationally recognized non-profit that unlocks the full potential of diverse and ambitious entrepreneurs to economically transform entire communities. Delve into a world of cutting-edge strategies, emerging trends, and astute perspectives in JumpStart's Blog.

feeds.title: Growth Capital Blog
feeds.description: Dive steep into Ohio's Venture Capital realm. Growth Capital's blog brings you a panoramic view of the ever-evolving landscape of investments and entrepreneurship, offering the latest news and astute analyses that shape the ventures of tomorrow. Growth Capital Corp is Ohio's number one SBA 504 and Community Advantage lender

feeds.title: Ohio Business Roundtable Blog
feeds.description: Access the latest news and updates from the Ohio Business Roundtable, our members, and policy issues pertaining to Ohio's competitive business climate. Stay up to date with what we're doing and what's been going on. The Roundtable is a nonpartisan, nonprofit organization comprised of CEOs of many of Ohio's largest, most successful organizations.

feeds.title: ECDI Blog
feeds.description: Stay updated with the latest small business articles, news, and valuable tips to fuel your entrepreneurial journey. The Economic & Community Development Institute is a one-stop resource for small businesses, providing education and capital to underserved entrepreneurs, building communities, and creating lasting positive change.

feeds.title: Ohio Valley Business Advisors Blog
feeds.description: Explore the art of exiting your business successfully. From preparing for launch to understanding diverse buyers and unraveling valuations, gain insights into the complexities of selling your business. The team at Ohio Valley Business Advisors provides competent and insightful professional services to business owners who want to buy or sell a business.

feeds.title: Zinner & Co. Blog
feeds.description: Zinner and Co. LLP, based in Cleveland, is a leading certified public accounting and management consulting firm dedicated to client success. Known for forward-thinking solutions, they prioritize adaptation to industry changes and client needs. Through personal and collaborative relationships, they serve clients, staff, and the community. Explore their blog for invaluable insights on business management crafted by Zinner's professional consultants.

feeds.title: Holbrook & Manter, CPAs
feeds.description: Holbrook & Manter is committed to keeping you updated on accounting news and tips, ensuring you stay informed about industry changes. Learn Business and Accounting basics through informative posts and stores. Holbrook & Manter is a leading CPA providing quality accounting services to businesses & individuals throughout Columbus.

feeds.title: Business Journal Daily
feeds.description: Since 1984, The Business Journal has built upon its foundation as the top resource to business and community leaders by promoting the growth of business and industry throughout Mahoning, Youngstown and Columbiana counties in Ohio.

feeds.title: Rev1 Blog
feeds.description: The Rev1 Blog provides expert entrepreneurial advice, access to capital & business growth connections to Central Ohio startups & entrepreneurs. Explore further to read on more business topics. Rev1 is a unique investor startup studio that helps startups scale and corporates innovate and provide the guidance, connections, and space needed to market ideas.

feeds.title: The Summit Magazine
feeds.description: Capturing the pulse of Summit county's economic vitality, The Summit Magazine is a trusted beacon for industry trends, market analysis, and entrepreneurial wisdom. Through profiles of local visionaries and coverage of impactful initiatives, it celebrates the spirit of enterprise driving the state forward

feeds.title: Ohio University Blog
feeds.description: Ohio University Library's business blog provides students with the best resources and advice they need to succeed in business. Explore specific guides and tutorials designed for academic courses and research needs.

feeds.title: The Business Backer Blog

feeds.description: Dive into a rich library of articles, essays, and case studies curated by the expert faculty, and industry professionals at the Ohio Business College. Stay ahead on career-related discussions with astute advice, tips and affordable options provided in the blog.
